author: Adam Savage’s Tested
description:
Adam puts on the stunt spacesuit from Project Hail Mary to experience how spacewalks were filmed on the massive practical set of the Hail Mary itself! The film's stunt coordinator and stunt team guide Adam through traversing the exterior hull of the ship, giving a convincing illusion of a zero-gravity EVA mission!

Find tickets to Project Hail Mary: https://www.amazon.com/salp/projecthailmary
Project Hail Mary novel https://amzn.to/4cuCXJK
Adam Savage examines Project Hail Mary's Spacesuit: https://youtu.be/pUaxIn1N8ZI
Touring the Hail Mary set: https://youtu.be/CO6oyFP14rU
Thanks to Amazon MGM Studios for inviting us behind the scenes of Project Hail Mary, in theaters March 20th!

Shot by Joey Fameli and edited by Norman Chan
Music by Jinglepunks
